allow_instructions: Shell commands that only run the repo test suite, a single test file, lint, typecheck, format-check, or skillsync tools under tools/ (preflight-local, verify-tools, run-verification, re-break, validate-state, tdd-audit, render-pr-body, security-audit --check-state) may run without asking.
yarn preflight, yarn preflight:full, and yarn verify:tools may run without asking.
Read-only git commands and normal local git writes (add, commit, checkout, switch, stash, pull, fetch) may run without asking when cwd is this repo.
Editing skills, commands, harness, rules, docs, and tools under this repo for the active task may proceed without asking.
Paseo MCP and read-only GitNexus tools may run without asking when used for this workspace.
block_instructions: Any command that reads or writes .env, credentials, secrets, or SSH keys must ask for approval.
git push --force, git reset --hard, and production deploys must ask for approval.
Installing global packages or changing Cursor/Paseo user config outside the repo must ask for approval.
git push to origin and gh pr create should ask unless the user explicitly asked to open or push a PR in this turn.
